definitions.explanation: A place where the dead are buried; a burial ground.

examples.japanese: {墓場|はかば}で{幽霊|ゆうれい}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw a ghost at the graveyard.

examples.japanese: {先祖|せんぞ}の{墓場|はかば}を{訪|おとず}れた。
{古|ふる}い{墓場|はかば}は{不気味|ぶきみ}だ。

notes:
ALTERNATIVES:
- {墓地|ぼち}: cemetery (more formal)
- {霊園|れいえん}: memorial park (modern euphemism)

IDIOM:
- {墓場|はかば}まで{持|も}っていく: to take to the grave (keep secret until death)
